question_template: For a {household_type} household with citizenship {citizenship}, first-timer status {first_timer}, average gross monthly household income of {household_income}, currently owning a {current_flat_type}, does the Step-Up CPF Housing Grant apply?

exclude_if.reason: owns private residential property: this grant needs no private property owned, or disposed of in the last 30 months

overview.quote: If you and your family are second-timer applicants, you may apply for the Step-Up CPF Housing Grant of $15,000 to help with your new or resale flat purchase.
